scores.tell: Clock rim is smooth glossy plastic with soft highlights; dial is flat matte. Close to the real towel and saddle, but the rim has little mix of matte and shiny.
Hat felt has a fine soft nap and the band is matte. Rim highlight is soft. Very close to the real cards. The only tell is slightly uniform satin.
Anchor body is uniformly glossy plastic with no material change. The rope has fine twist detail but the metal reads as toy. Looks like a statue.
Clock has the same smooth plastic rim and matte dial. Highlights are modest and there are no noisy marks. Slightly uniform lacquer on the rim.
Glass has clear, crisp highlights and the ice is translucent. The straw has fine ribs. The painted look matches the real cards. Small tell: the liquid glow is soft and a bit airbrushed.
Seahorse has soft painted skin with a matte-satin finish and small spots. It is very consistent with the real cards. None worth naming.
Beach ball is uniform glossy vinyl with large soft highlights. The sand grain is detailed but a bit realistic and noisy next to the smooth real cards.
Locker is all one glossy orange enamel with no wear or grain. The wood floor has fine grain. The shoes, books and basketball are well detailed. The metal parts are plasticky.
Clock has the same matte dial and smooth rim, with soft highlights. The rim lacquer is slightly even.
Anchor is a hard glossy blue plastic with strong specular streaks and a rubbery rope. It looks like a statue, like the grade 1 cat. There is no matte contrast.
